name: Suiei Choukyoushi ~Oyako Shuuchi Lesson~
original_name: 水泳調教師～母娘羞恥レッスン
source:
I am a swimming instructor. Actually, I just enjoy watching girls in swimsuit every day. There are two girls, Mizuki and Ryouka, who take part in my swimming lesson. You know Ryouka is Mizuki's mother. I am in love with Mizuki, but it seems she hates me. Ok, I will get you somehow. I just starts spying on Ryouka...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090302110513/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1009689]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
我是一名游泳教练。说到底，我只是喜欢每天看女孩们穿泳装的模样。参加课程的有瑞希和凉香两人，凉香正是瑞希的母亲。我喜欢瑞希，可她似乎很讨厌我。好吧，无论如何都要把你弄到手。于是，我开始偷窥凉香……
